proof: Every ordinarily shattered tree has zero disagreements on every branch and is therefore k-shattered. Its random-branch expectation is unchanged.
proof_source: Immediate from the k-shattered-tree definition in Section 2.2.1 of \cite{filmus2023randomized}.
witness_verification: For the two complementary constant concepts, $\mathrm{RL}^{\mathrm{mist}}_k=k+(k+\tfrac12)\binom{2k}{k}4^{-k}$, while randomized Littlestone dimension is $1/2$. Thus the gap is unbounded as $k$ grows.
name: Randomized $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension / Randomized Littlestone Dimension
